decision: Car = 6th-gen Civic EK 3-door hatch (1996-98 front, plate 8GEX521), NOT 11th gen; scan = Engineering Design/Honda Civic EK/EK Civic EK Full Car Scan.stl (Drive 1WXruE4JZOYiQK5A2VAZ3PopOXhhD2X_w)
why: Brief said 11th gen but every iPhone clip shows an EK hatch; the brief says to use the Drive folder that matches the footage. Folder is dated 2025-10-31, the day after the Oct 30 shoot, and the scan has the same multi-spoke wheels

decision: No part-state scans for the EK: the 1:1 cuts and the explode use the full-car scan only (panels cut out of it)
why: Drive search (EK, EK9, Civic) found only the full car (+ an unrelated customer dashboard and Russian EM/EK part CAD); the footage shows no panel removal either

decision: Scan: 3 mm vertex-cluster decimation (25.0M -> 4.9M tris), ive crop, yaw-aligned -14.725 deg about Z (tools/stl_yaw.py) BEFORE any camera solve, prep --drop-islands 3000
why: Car sat 15 deg skewed in the Artec frame; aligning before solving keeps explode axes simple and no solve depends on the old frame

decision: HUD triangle count = 24,997,508 (STL header of the raw full-car scan)

Music: start the track at 10.105 s; drop (first kick peak 13.305 s) lands on video 3.200 s = frame 96. Kick pattern repeats every 3.31 s (beat 0.4138 s); accents at beats 0, 1.5, 3, 5 of each 2-bar phrase
why: Lesson: no cuts on the quiet build, 1:1 cut ON the drop; anchoring on kick peaks (FG2 lesson). Track then runs to its natural end (~29.9 s video)

decision: 1:1 cut A: v_1957_24 @ 5.002 s (f150, camera settled after the pull-back; whole front 3/4 + crew powdering) -> full-car scan. cam_A = 12 landmarks, LM solve, then silhouette refine (GrabCut, person masked). f = 18.3 mm on the 20.25 mm portrait sensor, camera height 1.50 m
why: v_2003_40 crops the car in every frame >= 3.2 s. 28 mm (240SX value) gave RMSE 10 px with a visible scale error; the points span 2 m in depth so focal is observable here: free solve 18.3 mm, RMSE 4.7 px, onion shows grille/plate/headlight/mirror/roof aligned. Fixed it at 18.3 mm for the LM + silhouette refine

decision: 1:1 cut B: v_2003_29 last frame 3.501 s (f105, right front fender close-up at the end of the scanner pass) -> scan. cam_B = 6 side landmarks (marker lamp, molding ends, door seam), f = 28 mm, LM solve; hub + seam_bot dropped
why: Camera walks the side continuously (12 px/frame easing to 5), so I solved on the cut frame itself instead of absorbing drift. Side points are near-planar so focal was unobservable (RMSE 4.0-5.7 px for 14-28 mm); the far hood edge only lines up at 28 mm (=240SX iPhone 1x value). Front wheel was dropped because its steer angle may differ from the scan session

decision: Explode = front bumper, rear bumper, 4 wheels cut from the full scan (tools/split_parts.py: bumpers by region at the measured shut lines, wheels are their own mesh islands). Hood left on. No INSIDE claim
why: Rendered every part from behind: bumpers, hood and wheels are exterior skin only (back of the outer surface, mirrored plate). Lifting the hood would open a hole into an unscanned bay

decision: Timeline on the kick phrases (video t, track starts 10.105 s): IRL v_1957_24 0-3.200 | 1:1 DROP | S1 hero orbit 3.200-6.510 | IRL v_2003_40 scanner 6.510-7.131 | IRL v_2003_29 scanner pass 7.131-9.820 | 1:1 | S2 explode 9.820-16.440 | screen rec (scan alignment) 16.440-18.509 | S3 x-ray 18.509-23.060 | dissolve | WebZoom 23.060-end
why: Every cut lands on a measured kick accent (phrase starts or +1.5/+5 beats); holds vary 0.62-6.62 s per the 240SX pacing lesson

decision: Screen recording of the scan software sits between the exploded scan and the x-ray reassembly
why: Brief: software is a great beat between real footage and render; the alignment recording shows scan chunks snapping together, which leads straight into the parts going back on

decision: End card = the EK listing (illumaesthetic.com/products/honda-civic-ek-3d-scan-1996-2000), Playwright 1440x820 @2x. Hero viewer box 270,368-1694,1312 (1424x944); cam_L solved against the viewer's grey render (silhouette chamfer ~1 px, f 44.9 mm/36); cam_end = cam_L in the video frame with WebZoom focus 982,840 and startScale 1080/1424
why: Listing hero is a render of this scan, so ending the x-ray orbit on that exact view makes the dissolve read as one object (240SX lesson); simulated WebZoom frame 0 vs the morphed render shows no ghosting

decision: X-ray morph target: clay 0.06 / bg 0.015 (linear) -> rendered car median 136, bg 26 vs listing 135 / 26 (sRGB); x-ray accent neutral grey
why: Tuned from measured medians so the dissolve is a match; house style forbids colour on scan renders

decision: Explode layout from a frontal-high 3/4: front bumper forward+down, rear bumper back+up (stacked above the roof), wheels out sideways and rolling (x-200); bumpers turn left/right (z+38 / z-38)
why: First tries from a side 3/4 sent the bumpers out of the 9:16 frame; looking along the car puts the length into depth and the side-ways wheel throw fits the width

decision: Hero S1: 20 deg ease-in-out orbit from cam_A toward the car's left side
why: IRL camera is static at the cut, so the move starts from rest; 25 deg cropped the rear by the end of the shot
